body.statement: If \(\lambda_K\to\lambda\in[0,\infty)\), then \(R_K\to R(\lambda)\). The lower bound ranges over supported mixtures on legal deterministic arrays, and the upper bound uses only the deterministic collision statistic; both sides target the realized \(L_K\).
body.justification: The theorem converts a nonregular finite-array estimation problem into an exact one-parameter decision frontier.
body.gap: Kipnis obtains sharp minimax risk for large-alphabet testing, not absolute-error estimation of an affine COT endpoint over deterministic two-arm arrays.
body.consumer: A partition designer can report the irreducible estimation error implied by the expected number of cross-arm replications.
